'''Kerstin Eckert''' (born August 25, 1966) is a German scientist. She is the head of the Chair of Transport Processes at Interfaces, a combined chair of [[Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf]] and [[TU Dresden]] created in October 2016.
